visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a professional black snowboarding helmet and iridescent pink sunglasses stands against a vast snowy background. He wears a cream-colored ski jacket with a distinctive black and patterned band. He smiles broadly at the camera, introducing himself while standing still on the snow. (2) As he continues his explanation, the camera stays focused on his upper body. The bright sunlight reflects off his goggles, showing a faint silhouette of the videographer. He uses expressive facial gestures to explain the technique of 'carving,' appearing confident and knowledgeable in this wintry outdoor setting. (3) The scene shifts to a full-body action shot. He is now on his snowboard, gliding down a wide, well-groomed slope. He holds chunks of snow in each hand as a visual aid. He maintains a low, stable posture as he begins to initiate a turn. (4) He performs dynamic carving turns, leaning deep into the mountain and briefly touching the snow's surface with his hand. The background reveals other skiers scattered across the mountain and a breathtaking view of distant snow-capped peaks and valleys under a clear blue sky. (5) The video returns to a medium shot of the man standing on the slope. He holds snowballs in both hands, concluding his tutorial with a friendly smile. The lighting remains bright and natural, highlighting the textures of the snow and his technical winter gear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and positive arousal, introducing himself as 'Coach Andy.' His speech is clear and well-enunciated. In the background, an upbeat acoustic guitar-driven pop track begins at a steady tempo of around 100 BPM, creating a friendly atmosphere. (2) As he explains the 'carving' technique, his vocal delivery remains animated with significant pitch variability. A subtle outdoor ambient noise floor is present, but his voice dominates. The music continues consistently in the background, providing a rhythmic bed for his instructional narration. (3) The audio transitions as he begins snowboarding. A prominent sound of snow being sliced and sprayed (broadband friction noise) occurs with each turn. His voice shifts to a voice-over style, maintaining a calm but authoritative tone while describing his movements over the rhythmic BGM. (4) He finishes the lesson with a concluding remark, his voice returning to a high-arousal, cheerful tone. The BGM remains constant until the end, where it begins a slow fade. The overall mix is clean, with a high signal-to-noise ratio despite the wind and snow noise.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Introduction -> Concept Explanation -> Practical Demonstration -> Final Advice
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach viewers the correct mindset and posture for 'carving' in snowboarding, specifically addressing the common misconception about touching the snow through expert explanation and demonstration.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A professional and engaging sports tutorial that effectively uses on-screen text and high-quality field audio to deliver instructional content in a short-form format.
